description: Create a shuffled deck of playing cards. Returns deck_id and remaining count. Use deck_count to combine multiple decks (e.g., 2 for 104 cards).

count.description: Number of standard 52-card decks to combine and shuffle. Defaults to 1.

name: new_deck

deck_id.description: Unique identifier for the created deck

remaining.description: Number of cards remaining in the deck

title: New Deck
